name: FLOW.AI
overview: FLOW.AI is a responsive web application that helps users learn and practice yoga through interactive guidance and real-time posture analysis. Users can explore yoga poses in Watch & Learn mode with animated visual guidance and spoken instructions, or switch to Practice Mode for live webcam-based posture correction, voice feedback, and smart hold timers. The entire experience runs locally in the browser, providing a privacy-first yoga coaching experience without requiring user accounts or cloud processing.
